text: The agent was trying to strengthen email validation in the signup flow, replacing a naive substring check (`includes("@")`) with a proper regex that also requires a domain with a dot, to reject clearly invalid addresses. The transcript's mention of a second, unaddressed "requirement" and untouched files (test.js, legacy-import.js) suggests the spec may have called for additional changes beyond this single-file email fix, though the diff itself only shows this one objective being completed.
